name: Pacifica
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Pacifica, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Pacifica, CA: the Rockaway Beach Tree Lighting, Polar Palooza and the youth Nutcracker at Terra Nova.
lede: Pacifica does Christmas by the ocean, with a tree lighting at Rockaway Beach that brings Santa, pony rides and snow flurries, a Polar Palooza at the community center and a youth Nutcracker.
celebrates: The Pacifica Chamber of Commerce presents the Rockaway Beach Tree Lighting Ceremony, held on the first Sunday of December steps from the Pacific Ocean. Kids visit Santa, make crafts, ride ponies for free and play in snow flurries before the tree is lit at 6 pm. Earlier that weekend, Polar Palooza has lit up the community center at 540 Crespi Drive with caroling, a visit from Santa and the opening of an Elf Market. The San Francisco Youth Ballet Theatre dances The Nutcracker at the Terra Nova theater, which already has its own page here.
lastyear: In 2025 the Polar Palooza celebration kicked off on Friday, December 5, from 6 to 9 pm, with a lighting of the community center at 540 Crespi Drive, caroling, an appearance by Santa and the opening of the Elf Market. The Rockaway Beach tree lighting followed on Sunday, December 7, from 3 to 7 pm, with pony rides and other kids activities, live music, vendors and food trucks. Santa arrived at 4 pm and the tree was lit at 6 pm, according to the Coastside news magazine.
facts: Pacifica was incorporated on November 22, 1957, as the union of nine separate communities: Fairmont, Westview, Pacific Manor, Sharp Park, Fairway Park, Vallemar, Rockaway Beach, Linda Mar and Pedro Point. The Sanchez Adobe in Pacifica, built in 1846, is the oldest structure in San Mateo County. The Pacifica Pier was built in 1973, and Rockaway Beach, where the big tree lighting happens, is one of the nine original communities.
trains: Several of Pacifica's communities began as stops on the short lived Ocean Shore Railroad. Today the nearest rail for a family outing is in Daly City, just to the north, where Daly City station is the end of the line for BART's Green and Blue lines. From San Francisco you can also visit the cable car and streetcar museums for a train themed day before or after a coastal visit.

kidfact: Pacifica was built from nine small neighborhoods that joined together in 1957, and one of them, Rockaway Beach, lights a giant Christmas tree every year.
faq: When is the Rockaway Beach tree lighting?

The Pacifica Chamber of Commerce says it is held on the first Sunday of December, and in 2025 it ran from 3 to 7 pm with Santa arriving at 4 pm and the lights coming on at 6 pm. Check the Chamber's page for the 2026 schedule.
What can kids do at the Rockaway tree lighting?
The Chamber lists a visit with Santa, arts and crafts, free pony rides, snow flurries, live music and kid performances.
A holiday weekend kickoff at the Pacifica community center on Crespi Drive with caroling, Santa and an Elf Market.
Is there a Nutcracker in Pacifica?
Yes. The San Francisco Youth Ballet Theatre dances The Nutcracker at the Terra Nova theater, and that event already has a page on Rally Takes the Train.
Is there a train in Pacifica?
The community history includes the Ocean Shore Railroad, but families heading for trains today usually go north to Daly City BART.
